title: I Am The Globglogabgalab
blurb: Few characters have ever escaped a forgotten film this thoroughly. The Globglogabgalab is a bloated, book-devouring slug from Strawinsky and the Mysterious House, a 2011 animated feature that essentially nobody saw until a clip of his song surfaced on YouTube in the late 2010s. The voice is oddly gentle. The animation is not. Remixers spent the best part of a year bolting the tune onto anything with a beat, and the word became a password among people who were online at exactly the wrong moment. Somebody in the room will finish the line.
origin: The Globglogabgalab's song from the animated film Strawinsky and the Mysterious House (2011).
